## 58bdb4259aa2

**A1 — Reproduced override-contract defects; target left unchanged.** Generator SHA-256
`64b2ec0fe67d97d6f538a61883da1199a6cf5d60632a679cb153ea8ffa606dda`;
executed/catalog rule hash `0918e6697b9c`.

The exact reproducer at
`checks/audit/58bdb4259aa2/reproduce_override_contract.py` demonstrates four independent
contract failures on the current bytes:

- unknown `typo_axis=1` is accepted and returns a validator-clean grid;
- changing advertised `anchor_corner`, `asymmetry_force`, and `color_count` together
  produces byte-identical output at seed 23 / sample 4 / medium;
- advertised-valid `grid_n=7` is rejected at medium because the implementation validates
  against the narrower default draw band 9..11;
- hard seed 31 / sample 2 with `grid_n=11`, `n_cells=12`, and
  `position_bias=diagonal` returns only six nonzero cells after falling back.

The full calls, returned grids, exception text, observations, and hashes are in
`checks/audit/58bdb4259aa2/override-contract-counterexample.json`. The six-cell returned
input passes `self_check`; its actual selected-Racket output and authority hashes are in
`checks/audit/58bdb4259aa2/racket.json`. An attempted generic override-stage run was
interrupted after exceeding the outer command budget and is retained as running evidence;
the small reproducer is complete and exits zero only when all four defects reproduce.
No source under this audit target was edited.
